name: Apex Solventless Live Rosin Tier S | Sudachi (73-139u)
description: Sudachi is a strain bred and hunted in house by the Apex Team, and is a cross of Tahiti Lime #7 and Oishii. A Sudachi is a type of sour citrus fruit from Japan that is known for intensely sour and tart flavor, while possessing a pleasant aroma. Commonly used in desserts, sauces, or drinks, a Sudachi is a staple to making many Japanese dishes delicious! Sudachi has an intensely sour, tart, and citrus funk aroma that is reminiscent of a foul lime candy that all can enjoy!
